exclusion_detail: The abstract names E7 (an EPZ6438-based PROTAC). Its route from commercial materials is about 10 reactions: hydroxythalidomide 1b from 1a, bromoalkyl ether 1c-k, and the EPZ6438-type amine 2g (nitro reduction, two reductive aminations, ester hydrolysis, amide coupling, Suzuki coupling, Boc-type deprotection from 2a), then the final N-alkylation.

lead.label: E7
lead.why: Preliminary assessment identified E7 as the most active PROTAC molecule, which decreased PRC2 subunits and H3K27me2/3 levels in various cancer cells.

notes: The GSK126-based PROTACs G4-G12 take 3 steps (1a + 3-aminopiperidine-2,6-dione -> 1b; 1b + dibromoalkane -> 1c-k; 1c-k + commercial GSK126 -> G). GSK126 is used as purchased (all chemicals stated to be commercial). Not transcribed.
